scope: Fresh authored tutorial asset exercised through extracted workflow
agent_visual_review: completed six actual browser views and Blender overview/rear

refinements.defect: Roof segments appeared as uninterrupted strips and showed overlapping-surface artifacts.
refinements.cause: Overlapping tiles occupied the same profile without a shingle lap height.
refinements.change: Introduce a small lap slope, preserve underlay/support, add bounded toe offsets.
refinements.recheck: Distinct courses in the actual exported roof and overview views.

refinements.defect: Black ring around the rear kiln closure.
refinements.cause: Rear closure shared a plane with the end of the barrel shell.
refinements.change: Give rear closure its own termination plane with a small outer return.
refinements.recheck: Rear Blender and browser views show continuous masonry.

refinements.defect: Front wall read as radial colored strips.
refinements.cause: Per-object random tint was applied separately to structural infill strips.
refinements.change: Use continuous base tint for the bonded infill; keep variation on discrete bricks.
refinements.recheck: Front facade reads as one continuous body.

refinements.defect: Overly uniform bright ceramic and masonry; costly runtime object count.
refinements.change: Deeper warm/teal palette, bounded variation, reduced bevel segments; batch evaluated copies by material.
refinements.recheck: 7 runtime primitives; 527 editable source objects preserved; 81,632 triangles.

test_correction: Initial pot support ray began inside the table and falsely failed. Replaced with opposing material-filtered rays crossing the table/foot interface; all 13 actual-export rays passed.
limitations: Simpler, more regular and less painted/sculpted than the generated reference and historical hero assets.
Fixed footprint; seed varies finish, not architecture.
No real kiln simulation, LODs, physics, navigation or runtime performance certification.
Self-tested by the authoring agent; no independent-agent skill benchmark.
